company.name: Seater
company.shortDescription: Seater is a tech-based transportation solution that offers premium mass transportation services via a mobile application.
company.description:
Seater is a mobile-app based transportation service, that offers premium mass transportation services through our mobile application, to bring Parents unique school transportation services, wrapped into an intuitive user experience that is really difficult not to fall in love with.

The existent problems in mass school transportation in most of the world are evident, and needless to say, well agreed upon. 

Lack of reliability, safety procedures, consistency, and supervision, you name it. We are talking about an essential part of the daily lives of people, and something that directly affects them on a daily basis, for all of their lives. Millions and millions of people depend on schools to get around.

Seaters services extend beyond just B2C School transportation, and Corporates. It also provides SaaS solution for schools to organize their operations.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $100,000, or 44.44% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $891,741 to $1,589,960, a 1.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
